notes: MME's own frmSpellBook procedures run against the stock database. The list is a recording ListView read as 'number' or 'number:tag' per row in the order AddSpell2LV added it (the sort after it is recorded as an lv_refresh_sort event). 'char' is whether PopulateCharacterProfile built the profile for the loaded character.
Row cells are not compared here: AddSpell2LV is the rows family's. The class box holds 'none' (0) and the 15 classes; combos are given as ItemData lists.

data.spells is [number, name, learnable, length of Learned From, length of Casted By, magery, magery level, required level, Classes, [ability, value ...]]; data.classes [number, magery type, magery level].
The window's list-item click and the learned-spell colouring are stubs (UI after the list is built).
